observation: NIFTY futures sometimes establish price acceptance outside a causal VWAP value band and subsequently fail back toward previously accepted value.
mechanism: If attempted repricing attracts insufficient continued participation, price discovery can fail; trapped directional positioning and restored two-sided liquidity may then increase rotation probability toward the pre-existing equilibrium represented by signal-time VWAP.
null_hypothesis: After conditioning on time-of-day and volatility state, causally identified failed VWAP price discovery has no greater probability of reaching signal-time VWAP before re-breaking the failed discovery extreme than matched non-event controls, and has no positive directional-return uplift versus those controls.
alternative_hypothesis: After conditioning on time-of-day and volatility state, causally identified failed VWAP price discovery has a higher probability of reaching signal-time VWAP before re-breaking the failed discovery extreme than matched non-event controls, with positive directional-return uplift toward VWAP.

primary_endpoint.name: VWAP_HIT_BEFORE_FAILED_DISCOVERY_EXTREME_REBREAK_30M
primary_endpoint.event_success: future path touches frozen signal-time VWAP before it breaches the frozen discovery extreme

matched_control_policy.event_exclusion: control must not be a failed-discovery event
matched_control_policy.deterministic_tie_break: minimum absolute ATR/close difference, then minimum absolute-z difference, then earliest timestamp

stage_boundary.promotion_condition: Only ROBUSTLY_SUPPORTED may open a separately versioned strategy-design candidate.
